source.notes: ICSE Class VII school final term examination paper, English Literature (school not named). Header prints 'Final Term Examination 2017-2018', 'Std. : VII', 'Subject : English Literature', 'Full Marks : 80', 'Time : 2hrs.+15mins.'; examYear 2018 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name); durationMinutes 135 = 2 h + 15 min as printed. The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images. Every item prints its marks ([2+2] etc. are summed); the items add up to the printed 80. In Q II the short printed extract is reproduced in the first item of each group (A), (B), (C) only. The paper's own spellings ('Holme's', 'aimiable', 'Frankenstain', 'lime me', 'followin') are kept as printed. The chapter list for ICSE Class 7 English has no literature chapter; literature questions are suggested under 'reading' and word-meaning/synonym/antonym/sentence items under 'grammar-and-vocabulary-in-context'. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
